extName.message: BiBoost - Overseas Video Speedup for bilibili

extDescription.message: Smoother 4K playback on web bilibili for overseas users. Unofficial, not affiliated with bilibili.

autoFallbackHint.message: Switches to another working route when a video or live stream freezes or can't connect. On an unstable connection (e.g. weak Wi-Fi) it may keep switching and blank the picture, so turn it off.

customHintInvalid.message: Please enter a valid host (with domain, e.g. xxx.bilivideo.com).

feedbackBtnLabel.message: 🐛 Report a bug / Request a feature

debugInitial.message: No data yet. Open a bilibili video page.

debugNoDataAfterOpen.message: No data yet. Open this popup after playback starts on a bilibili video page.

stHintLeave.message: Tests each node using segments from the current video and quality; leaving this page stops the test immediately.

stHintBandwidth.message: This measures each node's theoretical maximum bandwidth, not the speed used during playback, so it's normal for it to be higher than the debug overlay.

speedtestCannotStart.message: Could not start the speed test. Make sure the current tab is a bilibili video page.

stGuideTitle.message: No video to test in this tab

stGuideText.message: Open a bilibili video and start playback, then click the extension icon and press "Test node speeds".

stGuideTextIphone.message: Tap the page menu (≡) at the left of the address bar and choose "Request Desktop Website", open a bilibili video and start playback, then tap BiBoost in the page menu and press "Test node speeds".

stGuideTextIpad.message: Open a bilibili video and start playback, tap the Extensions icon in the address bar, choose BiBoost, then press "Test node speeds".

stStaleText.message: The extension was just installed or updated. Refresh the tab to run the speed test.

stStaleReloading.message: Refreshing… the test will start automatically when it's done.

cdnNoteBackupUrl.message: Use the backup node provided by bilibili

mhToastAutoSwitched.message: Current CDN is slow; switched to backup node {host}

mhToastAllFailed.message: Playback isn't smooth on either the current CDN or the backup node

mhToastReloadBackup.message: Reload and switch to Backup URL

modeOffHintVideo.message: Does not touch CDN selection for regular videos; bilibili's original behavior is kept.

modeOffHintLive.message: Does not touch CDN selection for live streams; bilibili's original behavior is kept.

stLiveHintLeave.message: Tests each route with the stream of the current live room; leaving this page stops the test immediately.

stLiveHintBandwidth.message: The test competes for bandwidth with the live stream you are watching, so the picture may stutter briefly. Each route takes about {sec} seconds.

liveSpeedtestNoSampleHint.message: Start playing a bilibili live room first so the stream URL is known, then run the test.

liveSpeedtestCannotStart.message: Cannot start the test. Make sure the current tab is a bilibili live room.

liveSpeedtestUnavailableHint.message: None of the routes could be reached. Refresh the live room and try again.

mhToastLiveFallback.message: Live route is unstable; switched to International (ov)

liveRouteExplain.message: Live streams can't switch nodes freely like videos: bilibili assigns each viewer its own set of nodes, and other sets won't play. So you pick a preferred route type, and the extension switches to it within that set.

showDebugHint.message: Shows technical info such as the route in use at the top-left of the player, and lists it below too. Only needed for bug reports or speed comparisons.

staleTabText.message: The extension was just updated or reloaded; refresh the tab for it to take effect.

sortBySpeedHint.message: When on, nodes are sorted fastest-first as the test runs, and the order is kept until the next test. Applies to video and live; turn off to restore the default order.

stVideoLimitHint.message: Each node is tested until it downloads this much or this many seconds pass, whichever comes first. Higher values are more accurate but slower.

stLiveLimitHint.message: "Switch lag" is averaged over several runs; "Keeping up" pulls the stream on each route for a few seconds to see if it keeps pace. Higher values are more accurate but slower.

countryLabel.message: Country / region of the node list

allWarnTitle.message: Testing all nodes takes a long time

allWarnText.message: Testing all {n} nodes will take about {time} with your current settings.

allWarnAdvice.message: Each country's list already contains its fastest nodes. Pick a country (or the closest one) before testing.

autoSpeedSwitchLabel.message: Auto-switch videos to the fastest node

autoSpeedSwitchHint.message: After each video starts, your current country's nodes are tested in the background and the fastest one is selected and remembered.

autoSpeedSwitchAllNote.message: Unavailable while the node list is set to "All" — pick a country on the main page first.

autoSpeedWarnText.message: Because the ranking differs on every test, this has a major side effect: almost every video will briefly go black while the CDN switches.

autoSpeedWarnAdvice.message: If your chosen node usually plays smoothly, this brings no visible benefit. Worried about stalls but don't want to switch manually? Use "Auto-switch on failure" instead.

customHintDup.message: This node is already in the list.

customDesc1.message: For when your country isn't listed, or every node in the list is slow.

customClearText.message: All {n} nodes will be removed, and the first node of your current country will be used instead.

resetAllText.message: Advanced settings and the video and live node settings will all go back to their defaults, and the custom node list will be cleared.

importToastOk.message: Added {n} nodes recommended by the speed test to your Custom list. Choose "Custom" in the extension menu to use them.

importToastNone.message: The nodes recommended by the speed test are already in your Custom node list.

importToastFail.message: Couldn't add the recommended nodes to your Custom node list. Please try again later.

autoDetectText.message: Not sure which nodes are fast? The official speed test tool tests 300+ nodes and adds the 10 fastest to this list for you.

autoDetectTextIos.message: Not sure which nodes are fast? Run the official speed test tool on a computer to test 300+ nodes, then scan the QR code it shows with this device to add the 10 fastest to this list.

countryMissingHint.message: Your country isn't listed, or every node is slow? Try the closest country, or add your own nodes under {link}.

reportTitle.message: Report a problem / Request a feature

reportDescNote.message: What happened? What did you expect? Roughly when did it start?

reportContactNote.message: Leave your email if you'd like a reply from the developer; visible to the developer only

reportDiagNote.message: Diagnostics include your IP address, ISP, the last 10 minutes of extension activity and the IDs of videos watched. Only the developer can see them; they are deleted once the issue is resolved.

reportDoneEmailed.message: A confirmation email was sent to {email}; reply to it to add more details.

reportFailHint.message: Please try again later, or copy the diagnostics and open an issue on GitHub.

reportContactInvalid.message: Please enter a valid email address

reportErrRateLimited.message: Too many reports in a short time. Please try again in 10 minutes

reportErrNetwork.message: Could not reach the report server

reportErrPermission.message: Sending a problem report requires permission to attach diagnostics. If you prefer not to, use "Copy diagnostics" and open a GitHub issue yourself.

lotteryWinHow.message: How to join: download the CDN speed test tool, choose "Join the prize draw", enter your email, finish the test and send the report.

announceGone.message: This announcement has ended or been removed.

donateBoardSub.message: BiBoost is free forever with no ads, kept alive by patrons like you. Every tip is converted to USD and ranked!

donateGiveSub.message: BiBoost is maintained by one indie developer after work. Your support keeps the updates coming and helps test nodes in more countries!

donateNameNote.message: Shown publicly on the board; remembered on this device for next time

donateFine.message: Tips are voluntary gifts, don't unlock any features, put you on the board as soon as you pay, and are non-refundable. If you were charged twice or the wrong amount, contact us via "Report a bug" and we'll refund it. Payments go to the developer personally, not to Google, Microsoft or Mozilla. Amounts are converted to USD at the rate at payment time, and repeat tips from the same person are combined. If you switch computers or clear browser data, sign in to the same browser account with sync on to keep your spot on the board.

donateBoardNote.message: Ranked by all-time total; repeat support from the same person counts as one entry.
